Text.Content:
Last summer, Mark planned a strange holiday trip to a small iland. He was nervous at first—no one had visited the iland before, and the locals very polite but intelligent in a strange way. "Why are you here?" they asked, smiling. Mark explained he wanted adventure, but they just laughed. "You’ll see," they said.

On the first day, Mark seen a market with colorful clothes and beautiful jewelry. He bought a hat, wondered how happy it made him. Later, he tried local food and felt afraid when he saw a huge, strange fruit. "Don’t eat it!" a boy warned. Mark panicked, but he didn’t. The fruit was sweet, and he realized the iland was magical.

By the end, Mark wasn’t sad anymore—he had fallen in love with the place. "Next year," he promised, "I’ll bring friends!"
